text: dsh-mobile-plugin 是面向 DSH Web 配置的手机连接插件：它在本机 DSH 中运行桥接服务，通过本地 NATS Leaf 连接 NATS Hub，并以二维码配对手机。配对后可转发 DSH RPC 与实时事件，呈现会话、工具调用、审批和提问等移动端交互；控制台还可配置 Hub、检查连接并启动本地 NATS。适合希望从手机访问本机 DSH 的用户。需要配置 Hub 地址、账号和密码，以及可连接 Hub 的本地 NATS Leaf。

dsh-mobile-plugin connects phones to local DSH through NATS. It pairs devices by QR code and forwards RPC and live events, including sessions and approvals. The console configures the Hub and starts local NATS. Setup needs Hub credentials and a local NATS Leaf.

dsh-mobile-plugin 功能「手机二维码配对」：控制台生成带 Hub 连接信息和限时配对码的二维码，供手机应用扫描并建立设备配对。
dsh-mobile-plugin 功能「手机 RPC 桥接」：插件连接本地 NATS Leaf，将手机请求转发到 DSH 的 ApiProxy，并通过桥接提供会话等宿主能力。
dsh-mobile-plugin feature “Live event forwarding”: Forwards DSH events over NATS to the paired mobile client.
dsh-mobile-plugin 使用前须知：配对二维码包含 Hub 地址、账号、密码和 CA 信息，手机据此连接已配置的 Hub；桥接还会把 DSH RPC 与实时事件经 NATS 转发。
dsh-mobile-plugin 使用前须知：Hub 密码配置项标为 secret，但 README 说明配置仍保存于 profile 文件；配置 Hub 账号与密码后再生成配对二维码。

插件主动连接 NATS Hub，把 dsh 的 RPC 与实时事件桥接给 [dsh-mobile](https://github.com/EarhartZhao/dsh-mobile)。电脑不需要公网 IP，也不需要开放任何入站端口。

@dsh-earhartzhao/dsh-mobile-plugin README · 为什么需要它：dsh 通常跑在家用电脑或办公电脑上，没有公网 IP。手机直接访问不到它，而把 dsh 暴露到公网又会扩大攻击面。 本插件把连接方向反过来：电脑和手机都主动连接同一个 NATS Hub。Hub 只负责转发，插件仍运行在 dsh 进程内，因此会话、审批、提问、文件与工具事件都来自同一个宿主。 ```mermaid flowchart LR Phone["dsh-mobile
Android / iOS"] -->|"WSS 8443
C 端账号 + 设备令牌"| Hub["NATS Hub"] Hub -->|"Leaf 7422"| Local["本机 NATS Leaf"] Local -->|"localhost:4222"| Plugin["dsh-mobile-plugin"]

@dsh-earhartzhao/dsh-mobile-plugin README · 核心能力：| 连接 | 安全 | 移动体验 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 宿主主动出站连接，不开放入站端口 | 扫码配对，设备令牌可单独吊销 | 完整 RPC、实时事件流与历史分页 |
| 复用 dsh Typert Remote 与事件词汇 | Hub CA 随二维码下发，不内置账号 | 子智能体、审批、提问、队列与文件 |
| 本机 NATS 探测、启动与链路诊断 | 每台安装自动生成独立 `instanceId` | 插件页与回环控制台使用同一套配置 |
| 支持 npm、Release tarball、Git 与本地 link | 密钥不进入移动端 wire 或诊断结果 | 控制台内检查更新，升级后提示重启 |

@dsh-earhartzhao/dsh-mobile-plugin README · 快速开始：开始前准备三样东西：

1. 能运行 `dsh web` 的电脑。
2. NATS Hub 地址、C 端账号密码，以及 Hub 的 `ca.crt`。
3. 本机 `nats-server` 与 `leaf.conf`；没有时按 [AI 接入清单](docs/04-ai-onboarding.md)准备。

在 dsh 的「插件」页安装并启用：

```text
@dsh-earhartzhao/dsh-mobile-plugin
```

然后打开插件配置区，按页面顺序完成：

1. **连接 Hub**：填写 Hub 地址、账号和密码。
2. **获取 CA**：粘贴 `ca.crt`，或点击「从 Hub 获取 CA」。
3. **启动本机 NATS**：状态显示已连接后继续。
4. **配对手机**：生成二维码，用 dsh-mobile 扫码。

> App `0.1.7` 支持插件 `>=0.2.2 <0.3.0`，当前 `mobileApi` 为 `2`。版本或能力不匹配时，App 会在连接阶段明确报错。

@dsh-earhartzhao/dsh-mobile-plugin README · npm（推荐）：```bash
pnpm add @dsh-earhartzhao/dsh-mobile-plugin@latest
```

发布的 npm 包已经包含 `lib/`，安装时不会运行构建脚本，不需要配置 `allowBuilds`。也可以直接在 dsh 插件页按包名安装。npm 网页可能对部分网络环境返回 403，这不影响 registry 安装；包元数据可以直接从 [npm registry](https://registry.npmjs.org/%40dsh-earhartzhao%2Fdsh-mobile-plugin) 查看。

pnpm 11 默认有 24 小时的新版本发布年龄门禁。当天刚发布的版本可能暂时解析不到；需要立即安装时请显式指定版本。长期使用时可以把整包名加入 profile 的 `pnpm-workspace.yaml`：

```yaml
minimumReleaseAgeExclude:
  - '@dsh-earhartzhao/dsh-mobile-plugin'
```

@dsh-earhartzhao/dsh-mobile-plugin README · Release 预构建包：每次发布都会在 [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/EarhartZhao/dsh-mobile-plugin/releases/latest) 提供预构建 tarball：

```text
https://github.com/EarhartZhao/dsh-mobile-plugin/releases/latest/download/dsh-mobile-plugin.tgz
```

这种方式同样不运行构建脚本，适合无法访问 npm registry 的机器。

@dsh-earhartzhao/dsh-mobile-plugin README · Git 源码：使用 `link:`，不要使用 `file:`。`file:` 会复制当前内容，源码变化后 pnpm 不会自动重打包。Windows 上还要保持本仓库的 `node_modules` 没有符号链接；本仓库因此固定 `nodeLinker: hoisted`。

</details>

@dsh-earhartzhao/dsh-mobile-plugin README · 安装后必须启用：包被加入 profile 依赖还不够。插件页里的「启用」会把包名写进 `dsh.profile.bundles`，包内 `cordis.patch.yml` 提供的 `mobile-bridge` 行才会生效。

没启用时 `/mobile-bridge` 会直接返回 404。装好后如果仍显示「declares no dsh.bundle」，通常是 profile 里物化了旧副本；在 profile 目录重新执行 `pnpm install`。

@dsh-earhartzhao/dsh-mobile-plugin README · 安装后必须启用：脚本会安装新包、原地替换 `dsh.profile.bundles` 中的旧包名、修正 `id: mobile-bridge` 行的 `name`，并移除旧依赖。修改前会备份 `cordis.patch.yml`；备份中含有明文密码，不要提交。

@dsh-earhartzhao/dsh-mobile-plugin README · 升级后重启 dsh：宿主始终使用启动时加载的 JavaScript。升级插件后，磁盘上的版本可能已经是新版本，但运行中的仍是旧代码。

从 `0.2.45` 起，控制台更新按钮可以直接完成升级；如果宿主返回 `already-installed`，插件会自动执行一次替换，**不需要用户先卸载再安装**。升级完成后仍需重启 dsh：

- 终端启动：按 `Ctrl+C`，重新运行 `dsh web`。
- 桌面版：使用菜单「重启应用与 Host」。

控制台会在「插件版本」旁提示磁盘版本与运行版本不一致。
@dsh-earhartzhao/dsh-mobile-plugin README · 首次配置：手机使用插件里配置的 Hub 凭证，App 不内置任何账号。因此必须先配置插件，再生成二维码。

@dsh-earhartzhao/dsh-mobile-plugin README · 1. Hub 地址与账号：打开「侧边栏 → 插件 → `@dsh-earhartzhao/dsh-mobile-plugin`」，或访问：

```text
http://127.0.0.1:3080/mobile-bridge
```

Hub 地址可以填写完整的 `wss://<host>:8443`，也可以只填主机或 IP。缺 scheme 时自动补 `wss://`，缺端口时自动补 `8443`。

@dsh-earhartzhao/dsh-mobile-plugin README · 2. Hub CA：手机不内置任何 CA，信任锚来自二维码。自签 Hub 必须配置 `ca.crt`。

- 已经有 `ca.crt`：直接粘贴并保存。
- 不知道 CA 在哪：点击「从 Hub 获取 CA」。
- Hub 只发送叶子证书：按钮会给出在 Hub 上拼 fullchain 的命令。

CA 是公开材料，不包含私钥；`ca.key` 应留在管理机，不能上传到 Hub。

@dsh-earhartzhao/dsh-mobile-plugin README · 3. 本机 NATS Leaf：点击「启动本地 NATS」。插件会先探测 `natsUrl`，端口已监听时直接复用；否则启动已经安装好的 `nats-server`。

查找顺序：

1. `NATS_SERVER_PATH` / `NATS_CONFIG_PATH` 环境变量。
2. 控制台「手动指定路径」。
3. `$DSH_HOME/mobile-bridge/`、`~/.nats-leaf/`、`~/.config/nats/`。
4. 平台常见目录与 `PATH`。

新电脑还没有 `nats-server` 和 `leaf.conf` 时，把 [docs/04-ai-onboarding.md](docs/04-ai-onboarding.md) 整页交给这台电脑上的 AI，按清单安装并完成自检。

@dsh-earhartzhao/dsh-mobile-plugin README · 4. 测试与配对：「测试 Hub 账号」会逐段检查：

| 检查项 | 失败时通常意味着 |
| --- | --- |
| `local` | 插件没有连上本机 NATS |
| `credentials` | Hub 账号或密码错误 |
| `hub-path` | 本机 Leaf 没有桥接到 Hub |
| `certificate` | 二维码 CA 与 Hub 实际证书不匹配 |

全部通过后点击「生成配对二维码」，用 App 扫码。凭证或 CA 未配置时不会发码，避免手机拿到一个必然失败的二维码。

@dsh-earhartzhao/dsh-mobile-plugin README · 实例 ID：`instanceId` 是这台安装在 Hub 上的命名空间：

```text
svc.dsh.<instanceId>.<method>
evt.dsh.<instanceId>.<eventKey>.mux
```

字段留空表示自动生成。第一次启动时会生成 8 位 ID（4 位毫秒时间戳 + 4 位随机），写入 `$DSH_HOME/mobile-bridge/instances.json`。

- 同一台电脑上的不同 dsh profile 各自拥有独立 ID。
- 升级、重装、重启不会改变 ID。
- 修改 ID 或更换安装路径后，已配对手机需要重新扫码。
- 多个实例共用同一个 ID 会互相抢答，事件也会串流。

@dsh-earhartzhao/dsh-mobile-plugin README · 凭证与配置分层：| 层 | 位置 | 用途 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 组合层 | 包内 `cordis.patch.yml` | 非密默认值与 `mobile-bridge` 行 |
| 用户层 | profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` | 本机 Hub 地址、账号、CA 与实例名 |
| 凭据层 | 环境变量或 `dsh-credentials-local` | 推荐的正式密码托管方式 |

控制台「保存」写的是 profile 覆盖行。`hubPass` 标记为 `secret`，非本机请求只能得知是否已配置；但当前值仍会以明文保存在 profile 文件中，因此不要提交或公开分享该文件。

@dsh-earhartzhao/dsh-mobile-plugin README · 已知边界：- **大文件不走 NATS。** Hub 单条消息约 1 MiB，插件只传有界文件窗口；更大的文件需要独立下载端点。
- **目录列表没有游标。** 宿主默认最多返回 2000 项，超出时只标记 `truncated`。
- **CA 指纹尚未强制校验。** App 会保存并展示指纹，但 RN WebSocket 暂时拿不到对端证书。
- **没有系统级后台推送。** 审批与提问提醒目前只在 App 前台有效。
- **文件变更流不是操作系统监视器。** 只覆盖 dsh 自己记录的读写事件。

@dsh-earhartzhao/dsh-mobile-plugin README · dsh-mobile-plugin：**A Cordis plugin that brings a local DeepSeek Harness instance to your phone securely.**

The plugin connects outbound to a NATS Hub and bridges dsh RPC calls and real-time events to [dsh-mobile](https://github.com/EarhartZhao/dsh-mobile). Your computer does not need a public IP address or any inbound port.

@dsh-earhartzhao/dsh-mobile-plugin README · Why this plugin exists：dsh usually runs on a home or office computer without a public IP address. A phone cannot reach it directly, and exposing dsh to the public Internet increases the attack surface.

This plugin reverses the connection direction: the computer and phone both connect outbound to the same NATS Hub. The Hub only forwards traffic, while the plugin keeps running inside the dsh process. Sessions, approvals, questions, files, and tool events therefore all come from the same host.

Android / iOS"] -->|"WSS 8443

@dsh-earhartzhao/dsh-mobile-plugin README · Capabilities：| Connectivity | Security | Mobile experience |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Outbound host connection with no inbound port | QR pairing with individually revocable device tokens | Full RPC, live event streams, and paged history |
| Reuses dsh Typert Remote and event vocabulary | Hub CA delivered in the QR payload; no built-in account | Subagents, approvals, questions, queues, and files |
| Local NATS discovery, launch, and link diagnostics | A separate `instanceId` for every installation | Shared configuration between the plugin page and local console |
| npm, Release tarball, Git, and local link installs | Secrets kept out of the mobile wire and diagnostics | In-console update checks and restart guidance |

@dsh-earhartzhao/dsh-mobile-plugin README · Enable it after installation：Adding the package to the profile dependencies is not enough. **Enable** on the Plugins page adds the package name to `dsh.profile.bundles`, which activates the `mobile-bridge` entry supplied by `cordis.patch.yml`.

Without that step, `/mobile-bridge` returns 404. If the page still reports `declares no dsh.bundle`, the profile may have materialized an old copy; run `pnpm install` again inside the profile directory.

@dsh-earhartzhao/dsh-mobile-plugin README · Enable it after installation：<details>
<summary>Migrate from the old unscoped dsh-mobile-plugin package</summary>

The package name changed to `@dsh-earhartzhao/dsh-mobile-plugin` in `0.2.27`. An old profile override that asserts the unscoped package name will not match the new package, and the Hub configuration can silently stop applying.

Stop dsh, then run:

```bash
node scripts/migrate-to-scoped.mjs ~/.dsh/profiles/web
```

@dsh-earhartzhao/dsh-mobile-plugin README · Enable it after installation：The script installs the scoped package, replaces the old name in `dsh.profile.bundles`, updates the `name` on each `id: mobile-bridge` entry, and removes the old dependency. It backs up `cordis.patch.yml` before writing. That backup contains the plaintext password, so do not commit it.

</details>

@dsh-earhartzhao/dsh-mobile-plugin README · Initial setup：The phone uses the Hub credentials stored in the plugin; the app contains no built-in account. Configure the plugin before generating a pairing code.

@dsh-earhartzhao/dsh-mobile-plugin README · 1. Hub URL and account：Open **Sidebar → Plugins → `@dsh-earhartzhao/dsh-mobile-plugin`**, or visit:

```text
http://127.0.0.1:3080/mobile-bridge
```

The Hub URL can be a complete `wss://<host>:8443` address, or just a host or IP. A missing scheme is filled with `wss://`, and a missing port is filled with `8443`.

@dsh-earhartzhao/dsh-mobile-plugin README · 2. Hub CA：The app contains no built-in CA. The trust anchor comes from the QR payload, so a self-signed Hub requires `ca.crt`.

- If you already have `ca.crt`, paste and save it.
- If you do not know where it is, select **Fetch CA from Hub**.
- If the Hub sends only a leaf certificate, the button provides the command for appending the CA to the served certificate chain.

The CA is public material and contains no private key. Keep `ca.key` on the administration machine and never upload it to the Hub.

@dsh-earhartzhao/dsh-mobile-plugin README · 3. Local NATS Leaf：Select **Start Local NATS**. The plugin first probes `natsUrl` and reuses an already listening port; otherwise it starts an installed `nats-server`.

Lookup order:

1. `NATS_SERVER_PATH` and `NATS_CONFIG_PATH` environment variables.
2. Manually selected paths in the console.
3. `$DSH_HOME/mobile-bridge/`, `~/.nats-leaf/`, and `~/.config/nats/`.
4. Platform-specific locations and `PATH`.

@dsh-earhartzhao/dsh-mobile-plugin README · 3. Local NATS Leaf：If this computer does not have `nats-server` and `leaf.conf` yet, give the complete [docs/04-ai-onboarding.md](docs/04-ai-onboarding.md) checklist to the AI assistant running on that computer.

@dsh-earhartzhao/dsh-mobile-plugin README · 4. Test and pair：**Test Hub Account** checks each segment of the path:

| Check | A failure usually means |
| --- | --- |
| `local` | The plugin cannot reach the local NATS server |
| `credentials` | The Hub account or password is wrong |
| `hub-path` | The local Leaf is not bridged to the Hub |
| `certificate` | The QR CA does not match the certificate served by the Hub |

@dsh-earhartzhao/dsh-mobile-plugin README · 4. Test and pair：After every check passes, select **Generate Pairing QR Code** and scan it with the app. The plugin refuses to issue a code when credentials or the CA are missing, avoiding a code that cannot possibly work.

@dsh-earhartzhao/dsh-mobile-plugin README · Instance ID：`instanceId` is the installation's namespace on the Hub:

```text
svc.dsh.<instanceId>.<method>
evt.dsh.<instanceId>.<eventKey>.mux
```

Leave the field empty to generate it automatically. On first startup, the plugin creates an 8-character ID (4 millisecond timestamp characters plus 4 random characters) and stores it in `$DSH_HOME/mobile-bridge/instances.json`.

@dsh-earhartzhao/dsh-mobile-plugin README · Instance ID：- Different dsh profiles on the same computer receive independent IDs.
- Upgrades, reinstalls, and restarts keep the same ID.
- Changing the ID or installation path requires paired phones to scan again.
- Two instances sharing an ID receive each other's requests and events.

@dsh-earhartzhao/dsh-mobile-plugin README · Credential layers：| Layer | Location | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Bundle | `cordis.patch.yml` inside the package | Non-secret defaults and the `mobile-bridge` entry |
| User | The profile's `cordis.patch.yml` | Local Hub URL, account, CA, and instance name |
| Credentials | Environment variables or `dsh-credentials-local` | Recommended production secret storage |

@dsh-earhartzhao/dsh-mobile-plugin README · Credential layers：The console's Save action writes the profile override. `hubPass` is marked `secret`, and non-local requests only learn whether it is configured. The current value is still stored in plaintext in the profile file, so never commit or publicly share that file.

@dsh-earhartzhao/dsh-mobile-plugin README · Known limitations：- **Large files do not use NATS.** A Hub message is about 1 MiB, so the plugin transfers bounded file windows. Larger files require a separate download endpoint.
- **Directory listings have no cursor.** The host returns at most 2,000 entries by default and only marks the result `truncated`.
- **CA fingerprints are not enforced yet.** The app stores and displays the fingerprint, but React Native WebSocket does not currently expose the peer certificate.
- **No system-level background push.** Approval and question alerts currently work only while the app is in the foreground.
- **The file change stream is not an OS watcher.** It only covers read/write events observed by dsh.

@dsh-earhartzhao/dsh-mobile-plugin README · Development and verification：Requirements: Node.js 22+ and pnpm 11. Local integration tests also require `nats-server`.

```bash
pnpm install
pnpm run typecheck
pnpm run typecheck:client
pnpm test

Run an end-to-end check against a live host:

```bash
node scripts/fake-app.mjs nats://127.0.0.1:4222 <pairCode> home
node scripts/watch-probe.mjs nats://127.0.0.1:4222 home <scratchPath>
```
